category_name: Purposeful worker traces and coercive institutional storytelling
scope: Independent category 7 pixel review only; no overall score or native-source certification.

evidence.source_renderer_manifest_verification: All three current manifests complete; 27+4+4 counts and supplied source/renderer digests match. Native source and renderer files were not opened or hashed because they are outside this critic's evidence scope.

summary: The dock convincingly communicates bureaucratic control through inspection lanes, the speaking grille, tethered pen, stamp and paperwork, restricted storage and the covered trolley. The principal reassurance sign has a directly legible coercive reversal. The remaining shortfall is how specifically the workers and institutional strain are expressed: the desk reads as a tidy generic clerical station, pressure is only weakly established by wear/repair, and several supplementary narrative messages cannot be read at 600p.

credits.direct_visible: WE VALUE YOUR TIME / ALL DELAYS ARE YOUR RESPONSIBILITY
credits.interpretation: A clear reassurance/blame reversal, legible in the supplied original views.

credits.direct_visible: Speaking grille, physical stamp/ink pad, pen on tether, paper tray, clipboard, folded cloth, desk mug, keyboard and pulled-out chair.
credits.interpretation: Purposeful daily clerical work and controlled exchange; the layout and devices communicate procedure before text.

credits.direct_visible: SECTOR 04 / CUSTODY 731-A on cargo; DO NOT RELEASE and 731-A on the taped storage note.
credits.interpretation: Visual custody association supports restricted handling. Smaller intervening note text is not transcribed.

credits.direct_visible: Covered wheeled trolley, transverse straps/clamps, tall hook pole and adjacent lockable compartments.
credits.interpretation: Concealed handling and a medical/transfer implication. No occupant, corpse, abuse event or exact concealed contents can be established.

credits.direct_visible: Localized handle wear, wrapped conduit section, tagged control and floor-route scuffs.
credits.interpretation: Evidence of use/maintenance, kept localized. No random-clutter veto observed in this category.

deductions.title: Worker presence remains mostly a generic tidy clerical arrangement
deductions.visible_defect: The mug, paper piles, clipboard, keyboard and chair establish occupation, while the counter adds useful procedure. At the supplied resolution the desk offers little readable evidence of a particular worker, interrupted task or meaningful shift history; paperwork mainly reads as arranged work accessories.
deductions.scope_note: Deduction concerns specificity of human storytelling, not amount of clutter or geometry. The functional counter props retain full credit for their purpose.

deductions.title: Deterioration under institutional pressure is weaker than operational-control storytelling
deductions.visible_defect: Wear near utility handles, a wrapped conduit and one marked evidence compartment suggest maintenance and use. Across the larger work clusters these do not establish much specific accumulation, repair consequence or stressed workflow; the prevailing narrative is orderly functioning machinery.
deductions.scope_note: Active maintenance is credited. Escalation or institutional decline beyond those visible signs is not inferred from the brief or asset labels.

deductions.title: Supplementary coercive messages do not survive the current 600p views
deductions.visible_defect: YOUR WORK MATTERS and the factory icon are readable, but its lower copy is not reliable at this size. Clipboard copy and terminal lines are also too small/soft to support precise claims about contradictory rules or coerced procedure. This reduces the supplementary narrative depth beyond the successful main sign.
deductions.scope_note: No requirement that every form be readable; the deduction is limited to narrative meaning unavailable in the evidence. The main WE VALUE YOUR TIME reversal is directly visible and fully credited.

critical_statement: No category 7 critical defect identified. The numeric category gate nevertheless fails.
